recheck_2_replication_unknown_ceiling_cl.skill_definition_note: comprev-evidence-validator does not define `independently_replicated`. Its only replication requirement is REPLICATION_UNKNOWN_CEILING (<= 70% replication_unknown); iteration 2 applied the operative backing test that each non-unknown label cite at least one distinct, resolvable DOI. The stricter standard written into iteration 2's remedy text was 'same-endpoint/comparable-model replication'.
recheck_2_replication_unknown_ceiling_cl.ruling: SUPPORTABLE — the label stands. Explicitly: judged against the skill's operative standard (a non-unknown label backed by at least one distinct, resolvable DOI) the label passes outright; judged against the stricter same-endpoint/comparable-model standard from iteration 2's remedy, it passes on endpoint and mechanism but NOT on model identity. Two independent labs, with zero author overlap, each report the same two endpoints (survival; induced/hyperthermia-evoked febrile-seizure frequency) moving in the same direction after restoration of NaV1.1 function in Scn1a-mutant mice, by three different modalities (antisense AntagoNAT, prime editing, CRISPRa). That is independent corroboration of the finding's actual claim — that gene-therapy restoration of the interneuron sodium-channel deficit improves survival and febrile-seizure outcomes — rather than a same-model, same-reagent direct replication.
recorded_weaknesses: Model mismatch is real: study A is a K1270T GEFS+ missense knock-in, a different disease entity from Scn1a+/- haploinsufficiency; study B is a Dravet haploinsufficiency model but its exact allele is not stated in the record. The label therefore rests on conceptual (endpoint- and mechanism-matched) replication, not direct replication.

One of the two corroborating DOIs (10.64898/2026.07.12.737793) is a bioRxiv preprint, not peer reviewed. The peer-reviewed study A alone supplies same-endpoint, separate-lab corroboration, so the label does not depend solely on the preprint.

The cluster_09 metric rests on this single label: 60/86 = 69.77% versus a 70.00% ceiling, a margin of 0.23 percentage points. A reviewer applying a strict same-model direct-replication standard would revert the label, and the honest rate would be 61/86 = 70.93% with REPLICATION_UNKNOWN_CEILING failing for cluster_09.
recheck_2_replication_unknown_ceiling_cl.verdict: PASS — with the single-label dependency recorded as an auditable sensitivity, not concealed

verdict: PASS — all 27 applicable checks pass. Both iteration-2 failures are independently confirmed remediated: (1) cluster_03 finding 52 (10.1039/d4md00597j) now stores the verbatim abstract sentence (exact byte substring, 5-gram coverage 1.000) and its derived claim and effect_size correctly attach >300-fold subtype selectivity to the five sub-nanomolar compounds rather than to all thirty-three; an independent 5-gram sweep of all 51 abstract_only cluster_03 findings (87 sentence fields, 68 distinct sentences) found zero splices at coverage floor 1.000. (2) cluster_09 replication_unknown recomputed at 60/86 = 69.77% against the 70.00% ceiling; the single enabling label (10.1016/j.omtn.2026.102942 -> independently_replicated) was audited strictly: both cited DOIs resolve in Europe PMC, both corroborating studies report the same two endpoints (survival; induced/hyperthermia-evoked febrile-seizure frequency) after restoration of NaV1.1 function in Scn1a-mutant mice, and the three groups share no authors. The label is judged SUPPORTABLE as endpoint- and mechanism-matched independent corroboration, not as same-model direct replication; model identity is not matched and one corroborating DOI is a bioRxiv preprint. The pass therefore carries a 0.23-percentage-point margin resting on that one label, recorded under provenance.cluster_09_single_label_dependency. No finding, conflict or figure_data entry was lost in either re-save (cluster_03 112/108/11/7, cluster_09 86/85/9/6). Strict compliance rate 0.995 (840/844); the 4 residual non-passes are bioRxiv JATS-format exceptions with verified bodies. Three cosmetic documentation items remain open and are not gate failures.
